handoff: Approve: the integration regression test the ready gate asked for is in and asserts the full CLI flow (watch releases the claim, PR merges, sync takes the claim back, cleanup records done); both review#1 minor notes stand unfixed.

findings.title: Stories already closed with `norn story close` stay recorded active (carried over, not fixed)
findings.detail:
The take-back needs story.worktree?.exists, so gh-222, gh-271 and gh-292 (no worktree left) are never taken back and keep the 'issue closed — the round stays finished' Check item. The guard is what stops a re-cleanup loop; the handoff lists it under Not proven yet.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: The person lands status: done on the base for those stories by hand, or a follow-up issue settles them.

findings.title: A failed worktree removal makes later ticks take the claim back and re-run the cleanup (carried over, not fixed)
findings.detail:
cleanupMerged deletes the claim ref even when removing the story worktree throws. On the next sync the worktree still exists and the claim is none, so the take-back fires again. It is a retry, not a race (the acquire is create-only), and it stops once the removal succeeds.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as is unless it is seen in practice.
